main_title: The Flight of the Condor and the Eagle
main_sub: Pleroma is a flat space-time, and the prison is a curved one
header_desc: By intertwining 1st-century spirituality with 21st-century physics, this work tackles the primordial question of our place in the cosmos. The solution to quantum gravity is revealed in texts two thousand years old: the Gnostic gospels. The ego has mass; therefore, by releasing it, we free ourselves from matter.
left_title: Free Yourself from the Demiurge, You Sleep in a Prison with Open Doors
left_body: Matter tells space-time how to curve, and space-time tells matter how to move. If the ego curves space-time, the temporal plane of the cosmos emerges from our psyche, and the timeless responds to the pneuma. Consciousness oscillates between the states | ONE ⟩ and | EGO ⟩, granting us a free will of perception formalized in the inner product ⟨ ONE | EGO ⟩. In this context, the premise that the Father and I are one becomes a profound invitation to detach from the false self to return to the pure light of the Invisible Father.
universe_light_text: The revelation that the Father is the universe and that death does not exist frees us from ignorance. In the right hemisphere resides the timeless and divine plane, the high-frequency dimension | 999⟩. There lies the land of union and freedom (The Great Motherland).
center_text: The Kingdom of God is inside you and it is outside you – Gospel of Thomas (Logion 3): Sophia's wisdom in the right hemisphere versus Yaldabaoth's ignorance in the left hemisphere reveal the duality of human consciousness.
universe_mat_text: The human body is composed of carbon-12 (6p^+, 6e^-, 6n^0). In the left hemisphere lies the temporal and material plane, the low-frequency dimension | 666⟩. The gravitational force drags us to a place where: war is peace, freedom is slavery, and ignorance is strength (1984).
final_quote: When the Northern Eagle and the Southern Condor fly together in the same sky, Mother Earth will awaken, and humanity will heal.
p2_sub: Condor and Eagle: The Flight of Science and Spirituality
cap1_title: Chapter 1: The Prophecy of the Condor and the Eagle footnotesize color{golddark}(00:10 -- 01:07)
cap1_desc: Premise and framework of integration: the reconciliation between the South's intuitive wisdom (the heart, ancestral knowledge, and spirit) and the North's technological development (reason, science, and mind). The call for balance to begin the evolutionary awakening and transcend the state of duality.
cap2_title: Chapter 2: Quantum Gravity and the Illusion of Time (01:13 -- 02:42)
cap2_desc: The fundamental clash of theoretical physics: General Relativity versus Quantum Mechanics. Why Newton's and Maxwell's laws do not distinguish between past and future, Einstein's breakdown of simultaneity, and the dissolution of linear time as a neural reconstruction of memory.
cap3_desc: The Faggin--Segarra conceptual ensemble: the body as a vehicle operated by a conscious quantum field outside space-time, where qualia reside. Consciousness does not arise from the brain but precedes it, converging with the First Consciousness and the Intelligent Designer free of time and space.
cap4_desc: The Nag Hammadi discovery (1945) and the Coptic codices: the material cosmos not conceived as a home but as a prison for the soul. The teaching of the Gospel of Thomas (Logion 3): Jesus did not come to found a religion of dogmas but to liberate the inner spark from the Demiurge's prison through remembrance (gnosis).
cap5_title: Chapter 5: The Pleroma of Light and the Material Prison (08:43 -- 10:16)
cap5_desc: The time of no-time and the awakening foretold by Mayan cosmogony. The cosmological question of Yaldabaoth's origin and the revelation of the Pleroma: the transcendent kingdom of perfection, silence, and pure light where the Invisible Father dwells, emanated through Sophia (wisdom).
cap6_title: Chapter 6: The Dajjal and Brain Hemispheres (10:23 -- 14:38)
cap6_desc: Comparative eschatology and perceptual distortion: the figure of the Dajjal and the visual trick of the inverted paradise (the river and the fire). The mechanism of Orwellian doublethink (1984) as the cognitive prison of the ego, versus Jesus' revolutionary message that dismantles the imperial slavery system.
cap7_title: Chapter 7: Reflections on Our Place in the Cosmos (14:40 -- 16:30)
cap7_desc: The capital statement: I am the way, the truth, and the life; the Father and I are one (John 14:6). The confrontation before the question of questions: Is Jesus God in an immeasurable universe of over two trillion galaxies? The paradox of cosmic incarnation on a tiny planet.
sagan_quote: The idea that God is a white man, larger than normal, with a flowing beard, sitting in the sky and counting the fall of every sparrow, is ridiculous. But if by God one means the set of physical laws that govern the universe, then clearly such a God exists. However, this God is emotionally unsatisfying... there is not much sense in praying to the law of gravity
